identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study to Evaluate Efficacy, and Safety of QL2107 Plus Chemo and Compare With Keytruda in Participants With IV nqNSCLC
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double-blind, Multicenter Phase III Clinical Study to Compare the Efficacy and Safety of QL2107 Versus Keytruda® in Combination With Chemotherapy in the Treatment of Metastatic Non-squamous Non-small-cell Lung Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The goal of this clinical trial is to compare the efficacy similarities between QL2107 and Keytruda in metastatic non-squamous NSCLC.

interventions.name: QL2107
interventions.description: 200mg on day 1 of each 21-day cycle of the study

interventions.name: Pemetrexed
interventions.description: 500 mg/m2 on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle of the study

interventions.name: Carboplatin
interventions.description: Target AUC of 5 mg/mL/min on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle up to 4 cycles

interventions.name: Keytruda®
interventions.description: 200mg on day 1 of each 21-day cycle of the study

primaryOutcomes.description: The 24-week objective response rate (24-week ORR, defined as the proportion of subjects who achieve CR or PR based on best efficacy at any time within 24 weeks after administration, evaluated according to RECIST 1.1) assessed by the Independent Review Committee (IRC)

locations.facility: Shandong First Medical University Cancer Hospital
